How should alerts reach this device?

Through your own ntfy server and the ntfy app, which passes alerts to this app via UnifiedPush. No Google services involved. The ntfy app keeps a permanent notification; you can hide it by turning off its notification channel.
Through a small relay you host and Firebase Cloud Messaging of your own free Firebase project. Best delivery and battery life, no permanent notification. Needs Google Play services.
Uptime Kuma posts alerts to your relay, which forwards them to Firebase. See docs/push/firebase.md for setting it up.
Enter an https:// URL without query, e.g. https://relay.example.com
http:// is unencrypted: the relay token and your alerts can be read on the way. Use https:// unless the relay is on your local network.
The RELAY_TOKEN configured on the relay.
